commands: ros2 launch course_bringup patrol.launch.py namespace:=robot_a subscriber_reliability:=reliable record:=false
timeout 3s ros2 topic echo /robot_a/sensor_pose --qos-reliability reliable --once > evidence/pr05/qos-before.txt
ros2 launch course_bringup patrol.launch.py namespace:=robot_a subscriber_reliability:=best_effort record:=false
timeout 3s ros2 topic echo /robot_a/sensor_pose --qos-reliability best_effort --once > evidence/pr05/qos-after.txt

defect.reproducer: Launch with subscriber_reliability:=reliable causes QoS mismatch: publisher uses best_effort, subscriber requests reliable. Topic visible but no messages delivered.
defect.root_cause: QoS reliability policy mismatch. Best effort publisher cannot serve reliable subscriber. ROS 2 QoS compatibility requires subscriber's requested reliability to be compatible with publisher's offered reliability.
defect.proof_after: Changed subscriber to best_effort. Messages delivered on live stream and replay with QoS override. Verified via ros2 topic echo and ros2 bag play with qos-overrides.yaml
